name: All Things Are Possible
overview: Scripture reveals that nothing is impossible for the Lord, who sovereignly governs all things from beginning to end and accomplishes His purposes by His great power. The promise that Sarah would bear a son despite her old age illustrates God's ability to do what seems humanly impossible. Believers are encouraged to trust in God's guidance and strength, confident that He will uphold and direct them. This assurance rests on the truth that God's counsel stands firm and no plan of His can be thwarted.
